title: Married Into a Wealthy Family by Mistake - Now I'm Spoiled Rotten
genre: modern romantic comedy drama set in New York
premise: Mia, a poor young woman, agrees to a paid marriage to raise $100,000 for her mom's surgery, but marries the wrong man: Alexander Kane, the cold CEO of Kane Group, who secretly loved her since childhood (he was the chubby boy she knew at eight). She starts at Kane Group as a cleaner while her snobbish cousin works there as his secretary. Grandma Kane (Madam Kane Sr., the chairman) wants Alexander to marry Miss Sophie Collins, a scheming woman who pretends to be innocent. Tom Black, Mia's cheating ex-boyfriend and heir of the Black jewelry family, and his arrogant new girlfriend Chloe (a Yale graduate) look down on Mia. Lila is Mia's friend who arranged the original marriage.
